session_2025_11_18_findings.description: Critical findings from alignment debugging session
session_2025_11_18_findings.status: ✅ RESOLVED - Universal geometry offset solution implemented

symptoms: ARC and STR don't overlap in Blender - 9.3m gap in Y axis
Orange ARC elements on left, gray STR on right in viewport
problem.root_cause: UNIVERSAL GEOMETRY OFFSET ISSUE - Each consultant used completely different local coordinate origins. Attempting to align with a single offset was fundamentally wrong. ARC DXF center: (-1.6M mm, +280K mm), STR DXF center: (+380K mm, -311K mm). Spatial filter bounds were in STR-only coords, catching only 1% of elements.

attempted_fixes.conclusion: Offset adjustment wrong direction, made it worse

solution_implemented.name: Per-Discipline Extraction + GPS Alignment
solution_implemented.approach: Extract each discipline in native DXF coords with discipline-specific bounds, then align all to common GPS coordinate system

implementation.step1: Find Terminal 1 region in each DXF separately using density analysis
implementation.step2: Extract with per-discipline spatial filters in native coords
implementation.step3: Calculate GPS alignment offset for each discipline independently
implementation.step4: Apply GPS offsets during database population

ARC_native_dxf.method: Density analysis - densest 60m×40m wall cluster (608 walls)

STR_native_dxf.method: Sliding window - best match to 71 cols + 432 beams (found 53 cols + 466 beams)

blender_verification.visual_result: ARC (orange) and STR (gray) now overlap and form coherent building structure

critical_insights: 🔥 UNIVERSAL GEOMETRY OFFSET ISSUE is fundamental to multi-consultant DXF workflows
Each discipline DXF has arbitrary local origin (no coordination between consultants)
Solution: Extract separately with per-discipline bounds, align to common GPS afterward
Do NOT attempt single-offset alignment - mathematically impossible for multi-origin data
Original IFC with IfcMapConversion is the GPS coordinate ground truth
Density analysis works well for finding building regions in large DXFs
Blender 4.2.14 required (4.5.3 has extension compatibility issues)
